newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Thatcher to open HK airport bridge in April.
newsitem.headline: Thatcher to open HK airport bridge in April.

text.p: Former British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher will visit Hong Kong in April to open a huge suspension bridge linking the territory's mainland to the new Chek Lap Kok airport, the government said on Friday.
"I am delighted that Lady Thatcher has agreed to be the guest of honour at the opening of the Lantau Link," colonial Governor Chris Patten said in a statement.

The Tsing Ma suspension bridge, also called the Lantau Link because it connects the New Territories to the new airport on Lantau island, officially opens on April 27. The airport, still under construction, is due to open in 1998.
When Thatcher was in power, she negotiated with the late Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping over the future of Hong Kong. The talks led to a 1984 treaty under which Hong Kong reverts to China this July 1.
